name: magic-ui-marquee
blurb: Content scrolls continuously in a loop, horizontally or vertically.
description: Repeats and scrolls child content continuously in a seamless loop. Can scroll horizontally or vertically and pause on hover.
use_when: Logo walls, customer lists, or scrolling galleries where continuous looping adds visual flow.
avoid_when: Content requiring user control to pause — `pauseOnHover` helps but there is no keyboard pause control.
a11y: Continuous scrolling can be difficult for some readers. Pauses on hover but not keyboard-controllable.
